signature.name: VTask.truncateAugment
signature.type: {V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] -> (C : ChainComplex V ℕ) -> {X : V} -> (f : C.X 0 ⟶ X) -> (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (C.d 1 0) f = 0) -> ChainComplex.truncate.obj (C.augment f w) ≅ C

conventions.statement: For every natural number i, the i-th component of the forward morphism (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).hom is the identity 𝟙 (C.X i).
conventions.note: Recorded in the neighborhood theorem truncateAugment_hom_f.

conventions.statement: For every natural number i, the i-th component of the inverse morphism (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).inv is the identity 𝟙 ((ChainComplex.truncate.obj (ChainComplex.augment C f w)).X i).
conventions.note: Recorded in the neighborhood theorem truncateAugment_inv_f.
